description: commit/update the active plan record when you are changing the plan text itself (plan document write; does not execute tools).
embedding_description: Commit / update the active plan record. Writes plan content to focused memory + the knowledge base. Accepts {content} only — the platform derives the current step from the existing focused plan automatically. Does NOT execute tools (plan document write only). Distinct from create_plan (which accepts {goal, topic?, context?} and creates a NEW plan).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Writing plan content to focused memory and the knowledge base. upsert_plan accepts {content}. The platform derives the current step from the existing focused plan automatically. Do not confuse with create_plan (which accepts {goal, topic?, context?}).
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError: arguments do not conform to the schema. Common mistake: passing 'goal' (belongs to create_plan) instead of 'content'. FocusBufferFull: 3 items already focused — a prior plan must be completed or abandoned first. StorageError: database write failed.
